products.title: Taco Bell Verde Sauce Boss 2.0 Putter
products.body_html:
Green sauce for the green. Obviously. The Taco Bell® x SWAG Golf Verde Sauce Boss 2.0 Putter features stacked Verde sauce packets engraved across its silver head, carries the pattern down the grip and pairs it all with a bright green cover. That's a lot of green before you even sink the putt.

We took the Boss and reengineered it to be nearly face-balanced, shifting the center of gravity for better stability through impact. Widening the head by 5mm increased the MOI, reducing twisting on off-center strikes for a more consistent roll. We took the Boss and reengineered it to be nearly face-balanced, shifting the center of gravity for better stability through impact. Widening the head by 5mm increased the MOI, reducing twisting on off-center strikes for a more consistent roll. The precision-milled face keeps that signature Boss feel, while the refined design delivers a smoother, more controlled stroke. It’s everything you love about the Boss—now with enhanced forgiveness and performance.

products.title: Patriotic Abe The Boss 2.0 Putter
products.body_html:

We took the Boss and reengineered it to be nearly face-balanced, shifting the center of gravity for better stability through impact. Widening the head by 5mm increased the MOI, reducing twisting on off-center strikes for a more consistent roll. The precision-milled face keeps that signature Boss feel, while the refined design delivers a smoother, more controlled stroke. It’s everything you love about the Boss—now with enhanced forgiveness and performance.

products.title: The Vandal Too RAD Putter
products.body_html:
The Vandal Too is our take on a fang style MOI mallet putter, precision-milled in the Chicago area from 303 stainless steel and 6061 aluminum.

The fang back design strategically redistributes weight to the perimeter, significantly increasing MOI to stabilize the face and minimize twisting on off-center strikes. To sharpen your aim, the integrated half circle and rear cutout serves as an alignment aid, framing the ball perfectly for a cleaner, more confident setup every time you step over a putt.

The 303 stainless steel face features our signature Drip Face Milling, engineered to deliver a softer, more responsive feel while minimizing side spin on mishits. The result is smoother launch, more consistent ball speed across the face, and putts that hold their intended line better even when contact isn’t perfect.

To ensure a solid, uninterrupted feel, the rear 6061 aluminum section is fastened from the back, keeping it firmly seated against the face and eliminating any potential for rattling. Every detail is engineered for sound, feel, and long-term durability.

Finished in a combination of Tour Satin and Matte Black Anodizing, the Vandal Too reduces glare while highlighting the precision milling and surfacing details we’re known for. Built for players who demand maximum forgiveness without sacrificing feel or aesthetics, the Vandal sets a new benchmark for MOI performance.

PUTTER SPECIFICATIONS -

  • Weight 360 Grams
  • Designed, Milled, and Assembled in the USA
  • 303 Stainless Steel & 6061 Aluminum
  • Tour Satin & Matte Black Anodized Finish
  • Black Chrome Double Bend KBS Tour Putter Shaft
  • Tip Size .370
  • Midsize Gripmaster Black Leather Grip
  • Paired With a Matching, Made in the USA Cover
  • Right-Handed

products.title: Bada Swing! Neon Lights Boss 2.0 Putter
products.body_html:
You're gonna want to hear this. There's a place where legends are made, deals are sealed, and nobody asks too many questions. You know the one. Bada Swing! is a love letter to that world, built on the The Boss 2.0 platform and finished in murdered-out black Cerakote with neon pink that hits like a spotlight on a Saturday night.

We took the Boss and reengineered it to be nearly face-balanced, shifting the center of gravity for better stability through impact. Widening the head by 5mm increased the MOI, reducing twisting on off-center strikes for a more consistent roll. The precision-milled face keeps that signature Boss feel, while the refined design delivers a smoother, more controlled stroke. It’s everything you love about the Boss—now with enhanced forgiveness and performance.

products.title: Take Out Boss 2.0 Putter
products.body_html:
Some putters are inspired by the game. This one was inspired by a Tuesday night, a greasy paper bag, and the menu you've read a hundred times but still study like it's the first. Introducing the Take Out Boss 2.0, a love letter to the greatest menu in the world, precision milled, dressed in clean white Cerakote, with red handpainted details.

We took the Boss and reengineered it to be nearly face-balanced, shifting the center of gravity for better stability through impact. Widening the head by 5mm increased the MOI, reducing twisting on off-center strikes for a more consistent roll. The precision-milled face keeps that signature Boss feel, while the refined design delivers a smoother, more controlled stroke. It’s everything you love about the Boss—now with enhanced forgiveness and performance.

products.title: 5 Over Boss 2.0 Putter
products.body_html:
The 5 Over Boss 2.0 Putter is precision-milled from stainless steel and finished in black Cerakote, delivering a stealth base that lets the graphics hit with sharp contrast and depth. An oversized Lincoln 5 graphic dominates the head, layered with bold currency details that demand a second look. This isn’t just another colorway. It’s a collector piece, and a reminder that power has always been printed in fives.

We took the Boss and reengineered it to be nearly face-balanced, shifting the center of gravity for better stability through impact. Widening the head by 5mm increased the MOI, reducing twisting on off-center strikes for a more consistent roll. The precision-milled face keeps that signature Boss feel, while the refined design delivers a smoother, more controlled stroke. It’s everything you love about the Boss—now with enhanced forgiveness and performance.

  • 303 American Stainless Steel

  • Tip Size .370

  • Paired With a Matching, Made in the USA Cover

products.title: The Vandal RAD Putter
products.body_html:
The Vandal is our take on a high MOI mallet putter, precision-milled in the Chicago area from 303 stainless steel and 6061 aluminum.

By machining the face and weight from 303 stainless steel and the body from lightweight 6061 aluminum, we’re able to achieve extreme perimeter weighting. Approximately two-thirds of the head mass is positioned within half an inch of the outer edges, dramatically increasing resistance to twisting on off-center strikes. This high MOI construction promotes earlier forward roll, reduced skid, and faster transition into a true roll.

At address, the Vandal inspires confidence with a ball-width rear alignment ridge that mirrors the diameter of a golf ball for intuitive, precise setup. The shape provides a larger footprint for added stability, while maintaining a clean, uncluttered look highlighted by a single visible fastener.

The face features our signature Drip Face Milling, engineered to deliver a softer, more responsive feel while minimizing side spin on mishits. The result is smoother launch, more consistent ball speed across the face, and putts that hold their intended line better even when contact isn’t perfect.

To ensure a solid, uninterrupted feel, the rear section is fastened from the back, keeping it firmly seated against the face and eliminating any potential for rattling. Every detail is engineered for sound, feel, and long-term durability.

Finished in a combination of Tour Satin and Matte Black Anodizing, the Vandal reduces glare while highlighting the precision milling and surfacing details we’re known for. Built for players who demand maximum forgiveness without sacrificing feel or aesthetics, the Vandal sets a new benchmark for high MOI performance.

PUTTER SPECIFICATIONS -

  • Weight 360 Grams
  • Designed, Milled, and Assembled in the USA
  • 303 Stainless Steel & 6061 Aluminum
  • Tour Satin & Matte Black Anodized Finish
  • Black Chrome Double Bend KBS Tour Putter Shaft
  • Tip Size .370
  • Lamkin Sink HD Paddle Pink Stacked Skulls Grip
  • Paired With a Matching, Made in the USA Cover
  • Right-Handed

products.title: Sunken SWAG The Boss 2.0 Putter - Lottery Entry
products.body_html:
Precision-milled, pirate-approved, and pulled from the depths—this is one piece of sunken SWAG worth recovering. Forged from carbon steel and finished in a raw Japanese bronze, the Sunken Boss Putter looks like it was lifted straight off the ocean floor. The aged patina gives each piece the look of long-lost treasure, while the sole’s map-etched engraving charts a path to SWAG’s buried loot. Balanced milling and bold alignment lines keep your roll truer than any compass reading, and the matching Pirate Skull headcover completes the haul.

We took the Boss and reengineered it to be nearly face-balanced, shifting the center of gravity for better stability through impact. Widening the head by 5mm increased the MOI, reducing twisting on off-center strikes for a more consistent roll. The precision-milled face keeps that signature Boss feel, while the refined design delivers a smoother, more controlled stroke. It’s everything you love about the Boss—now with enhanced forgiveness and performance.
